lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: Next, please! What can I get for you today?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Yes... one coffee, please. For my friend. She is American...

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: Of course. What kind? Latte? Americano?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I... I am not sure. She likes it sweet, but not too sweet.

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: No problem. We have a caramel latte. It is sweet, but not too sweet.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Okay. Yes. One caramel latte. And... can I ask your name?

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: Aisha. And yours?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Macal. Nice to meet you, Aisha. This is my first time ordering alone.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَهْلًا بِيكُمْ يا جَمَاعَة فِي يَلَّا فْلُوئِنْت! أَنَا مَحْمُود... الكُوتشْ بِتَاعْكُمْ، وَالنَّهَارْدَهْ مَعَانَا مَشْهَدْ حِلْو جِدًّا.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: مَاكَالْ رَايِحْ يِشْتَرِي قَهْوَة لِنُور... أَوَّلْ مَرَّة يِطْلُبْ لَوَحْدُهْ فِي دُبَايْ! وَالْبَارِيسْتَا آيشَا بِتَسَاعْدُهْ.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: اسْمَعُوا كُوَيِّسْ عَلَى تَلَاتَة تَعْبِيرَاتْ: الأُولَى... What can I get for you today? التَّانْيَة... I am not sure. وَالتَّالْتَة... sweet, but not too sweet.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَبُصُّوا كَمَانْ... مَاكَالْ لِسَّهْ بِيِقَلِّدْ الإِنْجْلِيزِي الْبِرِيطَانِي مِنْ غِيرْ مَا يِحِسْ. يَلَّا نِسْمَعْ المَشْهَدْ مَعَ بَعْضْ!

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: Here you go, Macal. One caramel latte. Are you sure that is all? Your friend, she is waiting outside?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Yes... but no. She is not waiting. I will meet her at the office. Nour is... she is my colleague. And maybe my friend. I do not know yet.
lines.direction: earnest, a little nervous, slower rhythm

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: You like her. It is okay. So what does she drink usually? Do you know her order?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I am not sure. She always orders something... but I do not remember the name. It is brown, and it has milk.

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: A mocha? Or maybe a flat white? Do not worry. We can fix this. Is she a sweet person?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Yes, she is very sweet. But the coffee... sweet, but not too sweet. Does that make sense?

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: Perfect sense. So, one caramel latte for her. And for you? It is your first time here alone, yes? Try something new.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Okay. I will take an Americano. Black, please. No sugar. I need to stay awake. I live here since two years, but this city... it never sleeps.

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: Two coffees coming up. That will be thirty-five dirhams. You are doing great, by the way. Ordering alone is not easy.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Thank you, Aisha. Really. Yesterday I asked for a "cup of tea" and everyone was laughing. I think I sound like... a British man?

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: A little. But that is okay. You are learning. Here is your change, and your coffees. Enjoy, Macal.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Wait. Can I ask one more thing? When I give this to Nour... what should I say? Something natural. Not too... formal.

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: Just say, "I got you a caramel latte. I hope it is sweet, but not too sweet." Trust me. She will smile.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا نِفَكِّكْ تَعْبِيرَاتْ المَشْهَدْ... أُولَ حَاجَةْ: What can I get for you today? يَعْنِي إِيهْ؟ الْبَارِيسْتَا بِتَسْأَلْكَ عَايِزْ تِشْرَبْ إِيهْ. تِسْمَعْهَا كَتِيرْ فِي الْكَافِيهَاتْ. مَثَلًا... Good morning! What can I get for you today?

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: تَانِي حَاجَةْ: I am not sure. يَعْنِي... أَنَا مُشْ مُتَأَكِّدْ. لَمَّا مِشْ عَارِفْ الإِجَابَة، قُولْهَا بِهُدُوءْ. مَثَلًا... I am not sure, can you help me? وِتْلَاتَةْ: sweet, but not too sweet... حِلْوَة، بَسْ مِشْ أَوِي. تِقُولْهَا لَمَّا تِوَصْفْ حَاجَة.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَدَلْوَقْتِي... غَلْطَةْ مَاكَالْ. قَالْ: I live here since two years. الْغَلْطَةْ... كَلِمَةْ since مَعَ الْمُضَارِعْ الْمُسْتَمِرْ، مُشْ مَعَ الْمُضَارِعْ الْبَسِيطْ. فِي الْعَرَبِي بِنْقُولْ "بَاعِيشْ هِنا مِنْ سَنِتَيْن" — فَبِنْنَقْلْهَا زِي مَا هِيَّ. الصَّحْ... I have lived here for two years. زَمَنْ for، مُشْ since!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا نِلْعَبْ! الْمَعْمَلْ بَتَاعْ النُّطْقْ... صَوْتْ TH. فِي صَوْتَيْنْ: وَاحِدْ نَاعِمْ زِي think, ووَاحِدْ مَجْهُورْ زِي this. اللِّسَانْ بِيِطْلَعْ شُوَيَّةْ بَيْنْ السِّنَانْ... مُشْ س، مُشْ ز، مُشْ ت.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: مِنْ الْمَشْهَدْ... كَلِمَةْ three. لَوْ قُلْتْها تري بِالتَّاءْ... غَلَطْ. الصَّحْ... three. كَرِّرْ بَعْدِي: three! وَكَمَانْ كَلِمَةْ that. مُشْ زاتْ وَلَا داتْ. الصَّحْ... that. كَرِّرْ: that! that! عَاشْ! أَنْتَ بِتِحْسِنْ... وَاحِدَةْ وَاحِدَةْ.

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: Here is your change, Macal. And remember — sweet, but not too sweet.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Thank you, Aisha. I will try. I have lived here for two years, but I am still learning... how to speak like myself.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Macal! You got coffee? And it is... wait. Is this a caramel latte?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Yes. I got you a caramel latte. I hope it is sweet, but not too sweet.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: That is exactly what I always order. How did you know? This is so nice. Okay, now I have to tell you something.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Something good? Or something bad? Your face is... I do not know. It is doing two things.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Not bad. I just heard Tarek is posting his Rising Voices video today. And listen — this accent I have? People think it is British. It is not. I am from Michigan, not London.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Michigan... not London. So when I copy a British accent, I am copying nobody in the room.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Nobody but you, Macal. Hey — where are you going? Your coffee is still hot!

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Tarek's video. If he posts it today, I cannot wait for tomorrow. I have to make my own video... today. Right now.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلَّا، نِلَخِّصْ بِسُرْعَةْ... النَّهَارْدَةْ اتْعَلَّمْنَا: What can I get for you today? يَعْنِي عَايِزْ تِشْرَبْ إِيهْ. وَ I am not sure... أَنَا مُشْ مُتَأَكِّدْ. وَ sweet, but not too sweet... حِلْوَة، بَسْ مِشْ أَوِي. وَأَهَمْ وَاحِدَةْ... I have lived here for two years. زَمَنْ for، مُشْ since!
lines.direction: recapping fast and clear, ticking phrases off like a checklist

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَعِبَارَةْ الْحَلْقَةْ النَّهَارْدَةْ هِيَّ... I have lived here for two years. يَلَّا، قُولْهَا مَعَايَا: I have lived here for two years! بِصَوْتْكْ أَنْتَ... مُشْ صَوْتِي أَنَا.
lines.direction: proud, slows down for the phrase, then playful challenge

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَدَلْوَقْتِي، التَّحَدِّي بَتَاعْنَا... سَجِّلْ فُويْسْنُوتْ صَغِيرْ، فِيهْ تِقُولْ الْعِبَارَةْ دِي بِنَفْسْ النُّطْقْ بَتَاعْ النَّهَارْدَةْ... I have lived here for two years. وَابْعَتْهَا لِـ Empire English Community عَلَى تِلِيجْرَامْ.
lines.direction: warm, inviting, building excitement for the challenge

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: إِحْنَا هِنِسْمَعْ صَوْتْكْ، وَنِشَجِّعْكْ... وَاحِدَةْ وَاحِدَةْ. مُشْ وَاجِبْ، دَهْ بَيْتْ. اسْتَعْمِلْ صَوْتْ TH الصَّحِيحْ، وَخَلِّينَا نِسْمَعْكْ!
lines.direction: warm, belonging tone, ends with bright energy

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَنَا مَحْمُودْ... وَأَنْتَ مُشْ لِوَحْدَكْ. يَلَّا نِتْكَلَّمْ... يَلَّا فْلُوَنْتْ!
lines.direction: signing off with warmth and a smile

phrase_of_episode.en: I have lived here for two years

phonetic_focus.note: Two THs: voiceless in 'think/three' and voiced in 'this/that'. Tongue lightly between the teeth - not 's', not 'z', not 't'.
